description: Authoritative texture manifest (established M9; HD block sources added in M11; Minetest sources used in M12). Maps every BlockType to its per-face source PNGs (top/side/bottom). Paths are relative to the repository root and use forward slashes. A null face means no source texture is available for that face; consumers must skip null entries. Any non-null path that is missing on disk is a hard error for the atlas generator (scripts/pack_textures.py).

assets.grass_side_hd.png: derived composite: Grass004 top 25% over Ground037
